fields.Name: C1 -> C2.5
fields.Description: Gate G7.5 (owner PR 1, phase 7, dataset C1, criterion C2.5): every active pipeline version has a stored golden-set result at or above its declared accuracy threshold, 100%, and a version below it is refused activation, 1 of 1. Gates the installed job-title pipeline cloned onto a deterministic stub driver with a 52-title golden-set test at accuracy 0.9: the first version activates only through its stored golden-set result, a weaker version (40/52) is refused activation and refused a run, and every active gated version in the database has a passing stored result; no model calls.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A gated pipeline with no activated version is refused; its golden-set test (52/52) activates it with a stored result >= 0.9 and the next run completes; the next version scores 40/52 = 0.769, is Refused, cannot be saved Active, and its run is refused; active gated versions with a passing stored result: 100%.
